verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a 'Scheduled Chats' documentation page title. It suggests LibreChat can automatically run chats on a time-based trigger, a narrow form of trigger-driven automation, but nothing describes what it does or how it is configured. Missing for 10: user-definable event-based rules (e.g., on message, file upload or external event), configurable conditions and actions, any detail on how scheduled chats work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
